name: Project Buck
source:
Satoru is a 18 year old NEET that spends his time playing eroge and arguing with people online. One day he finds an AI software that makes fictional characters real. What will he do with that power?

[From [url=https://pandanavio.itch.io/project-buck]Itch.io[/url]]
